0022600228.text: The Pistons, 7-3 and first in the Central, visit the 4-7 Washington Wizards, who are 10th in the East and have lost four straight. Detroit has won its last game and is 4-1 on the road, while Washington is 2-2 at home. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), and Ugonna Onyenso (foot) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The Pistons lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-111 win in Detroit on November 9, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
